svg.text: What stops the parcel from spinning?
Matched release of an 80 g cuboid · Eight signed corner impulses · Independent 3D CPU reference
Genuine spin stops on the rough shelf
Lines show GPU motion. Dots show Rapier.
The original release had zero yaw spin.
Reversing the frame of the same shelf moved
the earlier CPU result from −26.27° to +26.25°.
With hard contact both frames stayed near 0°.
At 2.129 s friction removes 64.0 µN m s of angular momentum. The slick control keeps its spin.
